records.prompt: Create ONE Russian Bronze Age LIGHT CAVALRY mounted spearman idle game sprite. Reference 1 supplies the exact horse/rider overhead composition, chestnut horse with black mane and tail, leather tack, and painted game-art style. Reference 2 supplies the Bronze Age rider EQUIPMENT: rough hammered bronze domed helmet with riveted brow band, compact paired bronze pauldrons, bronze forearm bracers, stitched reddish-brown leather short-sleeved top, thick cream fur collar, dark leather belt, pale trousers and brown boots. Replace reference1's red cap and wrist wraps with this bronze equipment, and replace its club completely with one long wooden SPEAR with a broad leaf-shaped BRONZE spearhead like reference2. NO shield for this light cavalry draft; screen-right hand holds leather reins. Screen-left hand grips spear toward the rear half, hand raised near shoulder, long shaft extends forward beside the left side of horse and bronze spear point aimed screen-bottom-left, safely clear of the horse's head. Spear remains a straight rigid wooden shaft, visible grip, unmistakable broad bronze leaf tip, no axe or club. Calm standing horse, rider seated naturally in saddle, full tail, head, hooves, spear and rider visible. Keep horse unarmored, simple leather saddle and bridle. Exactly vertical overhead orthographic camera looking straight down, helmet crown and shoulders and horse's back dominate; nose screen-bottom and tail screen-top. No front portrait, isometric view, ground plane, cast shadow or scenic backdrop. ONE centered mounted actor, single idle pose, no formation or frame montage. Same clear stylized painted outlines/material texture and warm bronze palette as references. Square approximately1254px transparent RGBA canvas, fixed saddle/root center at canvas center, full silhouette with at least60px transparent padding on all sides. True alpha0 outside crisp antialiased silhouette, no haze, glow, symbols, words or extra gear. This is an imagined ancestral Russian roster matching the other game units, not a claim of historical Slavic equipment.
